name: io.github.hft-studio/pokerdata
title: PokerData
description: GTO poker solver data: NLHE/PLO preflop ranges, postflop strategy, EV. Free Starter key.

tools.name: get_started
tools.description: Onboarding overview of PokerData: the short set of questions that identify a new user's needs (game, format, stakes, goal), a menu of what PokerData can do for each, what is free without a key, and how feature or data requests work. Free, no key needed. Docs: https://docs.pokerdata.io/llm-tools

tools.name: submit_request
tools.description: Files a feature request or data request on the user's behalf with the PokerData team. kind "data" is missing coverage (a game, format, stack depth, spot, or solve); kind "feature" is a missing capability (a tool, filter, export, or endpoint). The user's question is sent to the PokerData team in their own words, with the summary and details, and the team reads every one. Free with any key.

kind.description: "data" for missing coverage, "feature" for a missing capability.

summary.description: One line saying what the user wants, e.g. "9-max MTT preflop at 25bb with ICM".

question.description: The user's original question that couldn't be answered, verbatim if possible.

details.description: Anything else that helps: game, format, stakes, stack depths, positions, how they would use it.

tools.name: list_my_requests
tools.description: List the feature and data requests this account has filed, newest first, with their status. Free with any key.

tools.name: list_games
tools.description: Lists the covered preflop games with their stack depths and positions. "nl" = no-limit hold'em 6-max cash (169-grid hands, per-hand EV in small blinds), "nl9" = no-limit hold'em 9-max cash, "nlmtt8" = no-limit hold'em 8-max MTT chip-EV (10–300bb, 1bb BB-ante; Fold/Call/Limp/AI/Open/3B tokens), "nlh8-hydra" = no-limit hold'em 8-max MTT chip-EV with a classic 0.1bb ante from every seat (10, 20, 30, 60bb; same tokens as nlmtt8), "nlh8-icm" = no-limit hold'em 8-max MTT with ICM: one stack table per scenario (near the money, 33 or 35 left of 200, 30 paid; final table, 8 left), uneven stacks, 0.125bb ante from every seat, EVs in tournament dollars; pass scenario (the games catalog lists them; stack alone works only where one table has that depth); decision nodes only, "nlhu" = no-limit hold'em heads-up for the title, chip-EV, both players at the stack (1–40bb), 0.125bb ante each, SB on the button; decision nodes only, "plo" = pot-limit Omaha 6-max cash (4-card), "plo5" = pot-limit Omaha 5-card 6-max (100bb, 1.2bb ante), "plo9" = pot-limit Omaha 9-max cash, "plo4hu" = pot-limit Omaha 4-card heads-up cash (SB vs BB at 10bb, 20bb, 30bb, 40bb, 50bb, 75bb, 100bb or 200bb, limps allowed, 4.5% rake capped at 0.045bb; history starts "SB"), "plo6hu" = 6-card Omaha heads-up (BTN vs BB, 100bb). Cash trees are not tournament, ICM, PKO, or satellite solves. nlmtt8, nlh8-hydra and nlhu are chip-EV; only nlh8-icm is ICM.

detail.description: Response detail. "compact" is the default and removes bulk maps; use "full" only when exact complete data is required.

tools.name: get_range
tools.description: The GTO range for one spot. `spot` is an action path of POSITION_ACTION pairs ending in the action whose range you want, e.g. NLHE cash "UTG_60%_HJ_Call", nlmtt8 "UTG_Open", or PLO "UTG_Open_HJ_3B". Add `hand` for one exact frequency and EV. Compact mode is default; PLO returns representative pure/mixed hands unless a hand is specified; plo5 returns the top hands by EV that take the action (limit up to 500 compact, 2000 full).

stack.description: Stack depth in big blinds, e.g. 100

spot.description: Action path ending in an action

hand.description: Optional hand/class, e.g. AKs; for 4-card PLO either cards (AsJsAhJh) or a class with suited cards in parentheses ((JA)(JA))

minFreq.description: Drop hands at or below this weight (PLO ranges are large)

detail.description: Response detail. "compact" is the default and removes bulk maps; use "full" only when exact complete data is required.

limit.description: Maximum compact rows to return (default 120, maximum 500).

tools.name: get_node
tools.description: Actions available at a decision node. `history` is an action path ending in the position about to act, e.g. "UTG_60%_HJ". sizeBb is the raise-to in big blinds and sizePctPot is the percent of the pot after calling (nlmtt8 40bb Open 40034 is 2.19bb; the pack label is 2.2x). evs are small blinds relative to fold. Compact mode returns action totals; add `hand` for its exact mixed strategy. full=true is full=1: all 169 hold'em hands with explicit 0, and no invented EVs.

Cash trees are not tournament, ICM, PKO, or satellite solves. nlmtt8, nlh8-hydra and nlhu are chip-EV; only nlh8-icm is ICM.

scenario.description: nlh8-icm only: the stack table, e.g. "33left-avg40-big-btn" (list_games lists them). Needed when several tables share the stack.

history.description: Action path ending in a position

hand.description: Optional hand/class, e.g. AKs; for 4-card PLO either cards (AsJsAhJh) or a class with suited cards in parentheses ((JA)(JA))

full.description: Hold'em only. When true, each action includes all 169 hands with weight 0 where the bundle omitted the hand. EVs stay only where the bundle scored them.

tools.name: get_config
tools.description: Table for one preflop game and stack, in big blinds: seats, stacks, blinds (sb 0.5, bb 1), ante, antePostedBy, stackIncludesAnte, openSizes (first-in raise-to), evUnit, evBaseline. Convergence is not published. stackIncludesAnte is true: the named depth is the starting stack and the 1bb BB ante is posted from it. openSizes at 40bb is open 2.2x (listing 2.2bb; node decodes code 40034 to 2.19bb) and SB 2.8x (2.8bb). 10bb is all-in/fold versus 50bb stacks, so stacks is null there. evs on nodes are small blinds relative to fold. Example: get_config({ game: "nlmtt8", stack: 40 }).

tools.name: list_spots
tools.description: Search valid decision nodes for a stack depth, tagged by depth (1 = RFI, 2 = vs open, 3 = 3-bet pots, …). Compact mode is paginated; depth, contains, and offset narrow the results. plo9 has no spot index; its decision nodes start from history "UTG".

detail.description: Response detail. "compact" is the default and removes bulk maps; use "full" only when exact complete data is required.

tools.name: list_postflop_packs
tools.description: Every solved postflop pack: preflop line, positions (OOP vs IP), stack, pot, the bet-size trees it is solved under, and the solved boards. Boards use the spaced form ("3h 3d 2s"). NLHE packs list `sizingTrees`: "75" (75% pot every street, the pack id itself) and "33" (33% pot on the flop, then 75%, under the `<pack>-flop33` id); every postflop tool accepts either tree's packId. PLO5 packs (ids starting plo5-) solve one 33% flop tree, flop decisions only. Compact output lists board names per pack. Pass `pack` (the 75% id or the -flop33 id) for that tree's per-board detail and per-flop exploitability where the index publishes a number. Missing exploitability is omitted, never estimated. Pass `variant` to list only NLHE or PLO5 packs. The returned pack ids and boards are the valid inputs for the postflop tools.

variant.description: Only packs of this game: nlhe (hold'em) or plo5 (five-card Omaha)

pack.description: One pack id (75% id or the -flop33 id): per-board detail and that tree's exploitability

detail.description: Response detail. "compact" is the default and removes bulk maps; use "full" only when exact complete data is required.

tools.name: get_postflop_node
tools.description: One postflop solver node: the acting player's strategy for every hand class, the legal next segments, board, reach and the reach-weighted action split. Walk deeper by appending a returned childSegment (an action like "Bet 5.5" or a runout like "deal:7c") to `path`.

pack.description: Pack id from list_postflop_packs. Use a sizingTrees packId to pick the tree: the pack id for 75% pot on the flop, or "<pack>-flop33" for 33%.

path.description: Segments from the root, e.g. ["Check", "Bet 5.5"]. Empty for the root node.

combo.description: Optional exact combo, e.g. AsKh (PLO5: five cards, as listed in the node's hands)

detail.description: Response detail. "compact" is the default and removes bulk maps; use "full" only when exact complete data is required.

tools.name: get_hu_plo_flop
tools.description: Heads-up PLO4 (pot-limit Omaha, four cards) flop strategy from the blueprint, at 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 75, 100 or 200bb, for any of the 22,100 flops (any suits or card order). Returns the acting player's range-wide action mix and EV, how the other player's range answers each action, and, with `hand`, that four-card hand's action mix, EV and percentile in the range. BB acts first on the flop. Walk deeper by passing a returned nextLines value as `line`. Flop only: turn and river are not in the blueprint. Preflop heads-up PLO4 is the "plo4hu" preflop game.

preflop.description: Preflop line that reached the flop (default "SB_Open_BB_Call"). Others include "SB_Limp_BB_Check" and "SB_Limp_BB_Open_SB_Call"; a wrong value lists them.

line.description: Flop actions before the decision, joined with "_", e.g. "BB_Check" or "BB_Check_SB_Bet50". Empty or omitted for the first decision.

hand.description: Optional exact four-card hand, e.g. AsKsQhJh

tools.name: analyze_hu_plo_hand
tools.description: One heads-up PLO4 hand, as played, against the flop blueprint in one call: every flop decision mapped onto the blueprint tree (sizes to the nearest blueprint size), and for each of the hero's decisions the best action, every action's EV for the exact hand, the loss of the action played (bb and % of pot), whether it counts as a mistake, the hand's percentile in its range and the opponent's response to each action. `hand` is a parsed hand history: big blind, the two players with starting stacks and hole cards, every action with street, type and chip amount, and the board. `hero` is the hero's player name. The stack is matched to the nearest blueprint depth. When this exact turn spot has already been solved, `turnDecisions` gives the same answers for every turn decision, and when that turn solve covers the river the hand reached, `riverDecisions` does the same for the river. Turn and river spots that are not solved yet are reported as unsolved.

hand.description: One parsed heads-up PLO4 hand history. Amounts are chips, in the same unit as bigBlind. Uploaded-hand summary rows are not this shape: they carry no stacks or per-action amounts.

handId.description: Optional id of the hand, echoed back.

players.description: Players dealt in. Exactly two may be seated (not sitting out).

playerName.description: Name as it appears in the actions.

startingStack.description: Stack at the start of the hand, in chips.

cards.description: Hole cards, e.g. "AsKsQhJh". Required for the hero.

isSittingOut.description: True if the player was not dealt in.

actions.description: Every action in order, blinds included. Bets and raises are the street total the player raised to; calls are the chips added.

actionType.description: What the player did. UNCALLED_BET is chips returned.

amount.description: Chips for this action (0 for check and fold).

isAllIn.description: True if the action put the player all in.

amountIsDelta.description: True if a bet or raise amount is the chips added rather than the street total.

hero.description: Hero's player name in the hand.

mistake_bb.description: Loss in bb above which a decision counts as a mistake (default 0.1).

tools.name: explain_combo
tools.description: Explains one exact NLHE postflop combo at a solved node. Returns a canonical context, the exact action mix, action EV/loss when available, made-hand and draw classification, blocker facts, and same-rank-class suit comparisons. The output is computed evidence; it does not state why the solver chose an action.

pack.description: Pack id from list_postflop_packs. Use a sizingTrees packId to pick the tree: the pack id for 75% pot on the flop, or "<pack>-flop33" for 33%.

path.description: Exact childSegment path from get_postflop_node, e.g. ["Check", "Bet 5.5"]. Empty for the root.

combo.description: Required exact two-card combo, e.g. As5s

format.description: Requested poker format. "cash" uses the cash trees. "mtt" is supported only for preflop chip-EV against game nlmtt8; ICM, PKO, and satellite remain unsupported.

objective.description: Requested optimization objective. chip_ev is supported for nlmtt8 preflop. ICM, PKO, and satellite return unsupported coverage.

anteBb.description: Requested ante in bb. nlmtt8 models a 1bb BB-ante; other positive antes return unsupported coverage.

tools.name: get_board_report
tools.description: Board-texture report. Aggregates action frequencies and range/action composition across solved boards in one postflop pack. Results explicitly report sample breadth and use equal weight per board.

pack.description: Pack id from list_postflop_packs. Use a sizingTrees packId to pick the tree: the pack id for 75% pot on the flop, or "<pack>-flop33" for 33%.

path.description: Exact childSegment path from get_postflop_node, e.g. ["Check", "Bet 5.5"]. Empty for the root.

filters.description: Texture filters applied to the pack's solved boards. All optional; omit for every board.

suitTexture.description: Most cards of one suit on the board. A three-card monotone flop is monotone.

highCardClass.description: Highest board rank bucketed: ace, ten through king, seven through nine, or lower.

connectivity.description: How many board cards sit inside one five-rank straight window.

boardLimit.description: Maximum matching boards to analyze (default and maximum 50)

format.description: Requested poker format. "cash" uses the cash trees. "mtt" is supported only for preflop chip-EV against game nlmtt8; ICM, PKO, and satellite remain unsupported.

objective.description: Requested optimization objective. chip_ev is supported for nlmtt8 preflop. ICM, PKO, and satellite return unsupported coverage.

anteBb.description: Requested ante in bb. nlmtt8 models a 1bb BB-ante; other positive antes return unsupported coverage.

tools.name: compare_strategies
tools.description: Compares two preflop or postflop contexts. Fetches both strategies server-side and returns action-frequency/EV deltas plus the largest postflop combo changes in one compact payload.

domain.description: Preflop contexts use game/stack/history/hand. Postflop contexts use pack/board/path/combo.

baseline.description: The context deltas are measured from. One side of the comparison. Preflop contexts use game, stack, history and optional hand; postflop contexts use pack, board, path and optional combo.

game.description: Preflop only. Both sides must name the same game.

stack.description: Preflop only. Stack depth in big blinds.

history.description: Preflop only. Action path ending in the position about to act, e.g. "UTG_60%_HJ".

hand.description: Preflop only. One hand or class, e.g. AKs, or for 4-card PLO cards like AsJsAhJh or a class like (JA)(JA). Provide it in both contexts or neither; PLO comparisons require it.

pack.description: Pack id from list_postflop_packs. Use a sizingTrees packId to pick the tree: the pack id for 75% pot on the flop, or "<pack>-flop33" for 33%.

board.description: Postflop only. Board in spaced form, e.g. "3h 3d 2s".

path.description: Exact childSegment path from get_postflop_node, e.g. ["Check", "Bet 5.5"]. Empty for the root.

combo.description: Postflop only. Exact two-card combo, e.g. As5s. Provide it in both contexts or neither.

comparison.description: The context deltas are measured to. One side of the comparison. Preflop contexts use game, stack, history and optional hand; postflop contexts use pack, board, path and optional combo.

game.description: Preflop only. Both sides must name the same game.

stack.description: Preflop only. Stack depth in big blinds.

history.description: Preflop only. Action path ending in the position about to act, e.g. "UTG_60%_HJ".

hand.description: Preflop only. One hand or class, e.g. AKs, or for 4-card PLO cards like AsJsAhJh or a class like (JA)(JA). Provide it in both contexts or neither; PLO comparisons require it.

pack.description: Pack id from list_postflop_packs. Use a sizingTrees packId to pick the tree: the pack id for 75% pot on the flop, or "<pack>-flop33" for 33%.

board.description: Postflop only. Board in spaced form, e.g. "3h 3d 2s".

path.description: Exact childSegment path from get_postflop_node, e.g. ["Check", "Bet 5.5"]. Empty for the root.

combo.description: Postflop only. Exact two-card combo, e.g. As5s. Provide it in both contexts or neither.

comboLimit.description: Maximum largest-changing combos for aggregate postflop comparisons (default 12, maximum 50)

format.description: Requested poker format. "cash" uses the cash trees. "mtt" is supported only for preflop chip-EV against game nlmtt8; ICM, PKO, and satellite remain unsupported.

objective.description: Requested optimization objective. chip_ev is supported for nlmtt8 preflop. ICM, PKO, and satellite return unsupported coverage.

anteBb.description: Requested ante in bb. nlmtt8 models a 1bb BB-ante; other positive antes return unsupported coverage.

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: List preflop datasets in the shipped tree documentation (stacks, positions, whether each bundle was analyzed). Preflop exploitability is not available.

tools.name: get_tree_docs
tools.description: Tree documentation for one dataset: coverage note from the shipped README and per-stack bundle or node counts from the shipped index. Does not read or modify range bytes.

tools.name: get_range_metadata
tools.description: Index metadata for one preflop game, stack, and path: bundle stats for hold'em/PLO bundles, or the matching node row for plo5 and plo6hu. Does not return a strategy and does not invent exploitability.

stack.description: Stack depth in big blinds, e.g. 100.

path.description: Action path, e.g. UTG_Open or LJ_Fold. Use (root) or empty for the plo5 root.

tools.name: get_postflop_range
tools.description: The range a player takes one flop action with, from a solved pack: hand-class weights ("AA:1,AKs:0.42,...", same format as the preflop ranges) after every earlier flop action on the path. `path` ends in the action whose range you want, e.g. ["Check", "Bet 1.8", "Call 1.8"] for the check-call range. Bet-size tree. "33" = 33% pot on the flop, then 75% pot on the turn and river, plus all-in. "75" = 75% pot on every street, plus all-in. Compact and full detail apply to the other range tools; this returns the action range itself.

tree.description: Bet-size tree. "33" = 33% pot on the flop, then 75% pot on the turn and river, plus all-in. "75" = 75% pot on every street, plus all-in. PLO5 packs are solved on "33" only.

path.description: Flop actions ending in the action whose range you want

hand.description: Optional exact combo (AsKh) or hand class (AKs) for one frequency instead of reading the whole range.

minFreq.description: Drop classes at or below this weight. Default 0.

tools.name: find_hands
tools.description: Find hands the account has uploaded. Returns hand_id, session_id, handAt, position, cards, game, board, potType, street lines, and netBb. Reads only hands this account uploaded. Docs: https://docs.pokerdata.io/llm-tools#hosted-mcp

session_id.description: Only hands from this upload session (see list_my_sessions).

game_type.description: Only hands of this game type. Matches hole-card count.

table_size.description: Only hands dealt at tables of this many seats.

position.description: Keep hands where hero sat in one of these seats.

isIpVsPfr.description: Hero was in position against the preflop raiser.

rfiOpp.description: Hero had a raise-first-in opportunity (folded to hero).

facedLimp.description: Hero acted after an opponent's open limp.

vsThreeBetAction.description: Opener's action vs a 3-bet: fold, call, or raise (4-bet).

flopFirstAction.description: Hero's first action on the flop.

flopFirstResponseToBet.description: Hero's first action facing a flop bet.

turnFirstAction.description: Hero's first action on the turn.

turnFirstResponseToBet.description: Hero's first action facing a turn bet.

riverFirstAction.description: Hero's first action on the river.

riverFirstResponseToBet.description: Hero's first action facing a river bet.

flopFacedBetPctPot.description: Size of the flop bet hero faced, as % of pot.

turnFacedBetPctPot.description: Size of the turn bet hero faced, as % of pot.

riverFacedBetPctPot.description: Size of the river bet hero faced, as % of pot.

flopBetPctPot.description: Size of hero's flop bet, as % of pot.

turnBetPctPot.description: Size of hero's turn bet, as % of pot.

riverBetPctPot.description: Size of hero's river bet, as % of pot.

sort.description: Row order: newest first, largest win first, or largest loss first (the default).

tools.name: get_hand_results
tools.description: Per-hand cumulative results for a winnings curve. `points` is [{ hand, bb }], oldest to newest, downsampled. Pass session_id for one session. Reads only hands this account uploaded. Docs: https://docs.pokerdata.io/llm-tools#hosted-mcp

session_id.description: Only this upload session's hands. Omit for the whole account.

max_points.description: Points on the curve after downsampling, 2 to 200.

tools.name: get_session_summary
tools.description: One uploaded session's headline numbers: hero, game type, start and end times, hands played, net result in big blinds, and HUD rates (VPIP, PFR, 3-bet, open limp) as percentages with the sample size. Returns an error for an unknown session id. Any key works, free trial included, and it never counts against the allowance. Reads only hands this account uploaded. Docs: https://docs.pokerdata.io/llm-tools#hosted-mcp

tools.name: list_my_sessions
tools.description: Recent uploaded sessions, newest first: id, hero, game type, dates, hands, and net result. game_type matches hole-card count. Reads only hands this account uploaded. Docs: https://docs.pokerdata.io/llm-tools#hosted-mcp

game_type.description: Only sessions containing this game type.

tools.name: get_tournament_results
tools.description: MTT results imported from tournament summary files. Money is in cents. Hand histories are not a source of buy-ins or prizes. Reads only hands this account uploaded. Docs: https://docs.pokerdata.io/llm-tools#hosted-mcp

tools.name: list_my_opponents
tools.description: Tracked opponents from uploaded hands. Each row has handCount, handsVsHero, and heroBb100Vs. Pass name to find one villain.

name.description: Case-insensitive substring of the opponent's screen name.

hero.description: Only hands where this hero name was seated.

game_type.description: Only hands of this game type, e.g. "NLHE" or "PLO".

min_hands.description: Drop opponents seen in fewer hands than this.

sort.description: Row order: most hands, most recent, or by hero's bb/100 against them (toughest = worst for hero).

tools.name: get_opponent_notes
tools.description: Leak notes computed from uploaded hands for one opponent, with the sample size on each line.

tools.name: get_opponent_limp_range
tools.description: Shown-hand first-in limp range: 169-class counts of hole cards villains showed after an open limp. Pass position for one seat. Sample is showdown-only. This is not a solver range.

opponent_id.description: Only this opponent's limps (see list_my_opponents). Omit for every tracked villain.

session_id.description: Only hands from this upload session.

table_size.description: Only hands dealt at tables of this many seats.

game_type.description: Only hands of this game type.

limit.description: Hole-card classes to return, most frequent first, 1 to 169.

tools.name: get_upload_link
tools.description: Returns the hosted hand-upload page, https://pokerdata.io/upload?utm_source=mcp_other&utm_medium=mcp on this origin, with a short-lived signed token for the caller's account when signing is configured. A person opens the URL and drops hand-history files there; it is the primary upload path.

tools.name: upload_hand_history
tools.description: Uploads a small pasted hand history or tournament summary (the hosted /upload page handles files). Runs the same ingestion pipeline as the upload page and returns hands parsed, tournaments parsed, and errors. Stored hands feed session summaries, results curves, and opponent notes.

filename.description: Name to record for the paste. Defaults to "paste.txt".

text.description: Raw hand history or tournament summary text.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get the price and buy link for each PokerData game bundle: one-time USD price, the pack-by-pack price for comparison, what is in the bundle (stack depths, postflop archives) and the page where it is bought. Pass `game` for one bundle, or omit it for all of them. Read-only; nothing is purchased.

game.description: Optional bundle/game slug to price one bundle, e.g. "nlh-mtt-8max" or "nlh-6max". Omit for every bundle.
